round1_to_round2.independence_verdict: Partly anchored, mostly for good reasons. All five adopted the facts I verified in round 1: $4.60 FY27 consensus, the Q2 tax add-back, ~98M diluted shares (several copied my 95.7M build line for line), ~$0.2-0.25B net cash, and 650k/930k capacity. Agreement on those facts reflects one shared source (my file plus the same filings), not five independent confirmations. The valuation work is more independent. Fair values did not converge on my $97: all five ended below it ($79-93, from $93-120). Four agents (1, 3, 4, 5) independently recomputed Innolight/Eoptolink from the source and overturned my CY2027 claim, and agents 1, 2 and 3 pushed back on my 21x median as too narrow. The 1-month ladders are the clearest case of anchoring: all five are near-identical lognormals (P(>=spot) 0.485-0.490) built on my event-timing check. The 12-month ladders cluster tightly (P(>=116) 0.393-0.442) because every agent now stacks the same downward corrections. Some of them (a 10% EPS haircut plus a structural multiple discount plus horizon compression plus a ~28% bear weight) partly double-count the same risks, so the spread understates the real uncertainty.

disagreements.resolution: My round-1 claim was wrong and I withdraw it. The source's own forecast tables (S&P Global data) give Innolight CY26 EPS CNY 29.94 and CY27 66.50 at a price of 808.44: 27.0x CY26 and 12.16x CY27. Eoptolink CY26 is 17.48 and CY27 35.68 at 389.00: 22.25x and 10.90x. 15.75x and 18.65x match neither column, and the implied blend weights differ (about 58% vs 19% CY27), so the figure is not one consistent NTM either. Agent 2's cross-check does have a point. The GS note on Innolight puts Bloomberg 2027 NI consensus at ~RMB61B (GS's RMB86.9B is '42% above'), and market cap 951.08B / 61B = ~15.6x. S&P's CY27 EPS implies ~RMB78B, so the CY27 consensus for the Chinese leaders varies widely by provider: Innolight is 12-16x and Eoptolink 11-19x on CY27. Both remain the cheapest names in the set either way, and the core-6 median is 21.5x on either figure (it does not move). For the record, agents 1, 3, 4 and 5 are right on the arithmetic and agent 2's label is wrong.

(4) Require agents to show whether the EPS haircut, multiple discount and bear weight count the same risk twice.
